visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and an olive green halter top holds a smartphone in a selfie position, smiling broadly and shouting with extreme excitement. Standing beside her is a middle-aged man with glasses, wearing a navy blue jacket with 'KAOHSIUNG CITY' printed on it. They both perform hand-heart gestures towards the lens while the man waves cheerfully. The setting is a dimly lit indoor event space with dark walls and wooden door frames in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit indoor restaurant environment. A woman with long dark hair tied back, wearing a blue denim top and several necklaces, sits at a dining table and speaks animatedly while gesturing with her hands. She occasionally forms heart shapes with her fingers. In the background, other patrons are visible dining at tables under warm, bright indoor lighting, creating a casual social atmosphere.
